[SWS_UCM_00245]
⌊
DRAFT
g
Software Cluster category
⌈
UCM
shall not remove a
SoftwareCluster
that has category set to
PLATFORM_CORE
.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00028,
RS_UCM_00029)
A
Software Package
has to be modelled as a so-called
SoftwareCluster
which
describes the content of a
Software Package
that is downloaded or uploaded to the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
, see [9].
The term
Software Package
is used for the "physical", uploadable
Software
Package
that is processed by
UCM
whereas the term
SoftwareCluster
is used
